prompts.source: race frame: Tokyo street race, chapter time 0 (night), lap 0.95, 1920x1080 (tmp/pixel-art/variants.mjs)
prompts.prompt: Use your built-in image_gen tool, not code, to draw exactly one image at 1672x941. The first attached image is a frame from our racing game. Repaint it as a finished hand-drawn pixel-art illustration in the exact style of the second and third attached images (our cutscene art): crisp visible art pixels, rich detail, legible Japanese lettering, clear faces, rooms visible inside lit windows. Keep the first image's camera, composition and layout exactly: the same street, buildings, signs and their positions, the two cars in the same places, the same road markings. Mood: a rainy 1986 Tokyo night: navy sky with stars and pink-lit clouds, a wet mirror road with long warm gold reflections, warm lit windows and shop fronts, glowing street lamps, red tail-light reflections. Every SORA logo must be the exact emblem in the fourth attached image, centred on its sign or car, never a kanji or an approximation. 1986 Japan only. Do not create, edit or delete any files yourself. Reply with only the absolute path of the PNG that image_gen produced.
